headline: Executive order creates a White House Council on Native American Affairs.
what_it_does: This 2013 executive order from President Barack Obama sets up a new White House Council on Native American Affairs. Based on the title, the council focuses on federal policy and issues that affect Native Americans. No summary was provided, so details such as who sits on the council and what its exact duties are are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Native American tribes and tribal members
who_it_affects.how: A White House council now exists to focus on issues affecting them.
Agencies may take part in or work with the new council on Native American issues.
